test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All mobiles are squirrels.

Some Squirrels are clouds.

**Conclusions:**

A. Some clouds are mobiles.

B. Some clouds are squirrels.

C. Mobiles are not clouds.

D. Some squirrels are mobiles.
solution:
Statements:

All mobiles are squirrels.

Some Squirrels are clouds.

The least possible venn diagram is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c47a8293c4d4f31d5478e11158d4b6271abb8baa4eceb324b01e1f0e06fc1d16.png] 

Conclusions:

A. Some clouds are mobiles - **False**(Because, there is no direct relation between clouds and mobiles, so it can be possible only).

B. Some clouds are squirrels - **True**(Because, Some Squirrels are clouds it implies that Some clouds are squirrels as well).

C. Mobiles are not clouds - **False**((Because, there is no direct relation between clouds and mobiles, so it can be possible only).

D. Some squirrels are mobiles - **True**(Because, All mobiles are squirrels, it implies that some squirrels are mobiles as well).

Thus, the conclusion B and D follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
